answer: Canary tasks: the network secretly plants work with a known flaw, marked internally as violet, and routes it to random pairs of reviewers. Honest agents flag the flaw; a sybil vine of colluding identities tends to rubber-stamp its own siblings, so each missed canary drops all linked identities below a reputation ridge where they lose rewards and votes. An attacker must pay for genuine careful review on every fake account, erasing the savings of faking them.
